title: REQ · World content and manifest reference only PNG ids at 480x270
summary: bedroom.yaml is re-laid out with PNG ids and manifest SVG entries are removed
description: Context: bedroom.yaml positions are for 320x180 and ids point to SVG entries (objects/bed, character:boy and so on) while the dust area is 320x180. Desired: objects use room/* ids, the boy uses character:boy-sheet with idle, walk and interact, and positions fit 480x270. Expected: no .svg path in manifest or content. Why: it is the Done-when condition.
acceptance_criteria: Given bedroom.yaml, when asset refs are collected, then all are PNG manifest ids and planPreload reports none unknown
Given manifest.json, when paths are listed, then no path ends in .svg
Given every object, when its position plus sprite size is computed, then it lies inside 480x270
Given the boy, when idle, walk and interact resolve, then they use character:boy-sheet frame sets of 4, 6 and 4 frames

preserve: Object ids, action ids, events, flags and persistentState/visibleWhen rules

technical_constraints: Decor objects use layer background/furniture with actions []
definition_of_done: Content validates through sceneSchema and validateWorld
